title: Almond Canadian Casserole
description: A warm and sweet Canadian dessert casserole made with almonds. It's a delicious treat to enjoy during the winter months.
instructions: Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with butter and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the almond flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, maple syrup, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until well combined.
Stir in the chopped almonds and all-purpose flour.
Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
